confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from a search result showing the 18 Nov 2026 observation. Food and drink anchors are based on one search of Numbeo and similar aggregators. They gave beer about EUR 3.43, cappuccino about EUR 3.70, an inexpensive meal about EUR 10.30, and a mid-range meal for two about EUR 51.49. I found no Gdansk cocktail price, so the cocktail is estimated at roughly 2.3 times the beer price. The wine glass is estimated from the mid-range bottle price plus a restaurant markup. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. July is peak season in Gdansk, so I have raised them. They are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gdansk is compared with other mid-sized Polish tourist cities such as Krakow and Wroclaw. Its summer Baltic-coast demand pushes accommodation prices up.
